query: I work for a private company in New South Wales and was dismissed shortly after reporting safety concerns and unpaid overtime. The employer says I was terminated for poor performance. Please separate any Commonwealth and NSW issues, identify urgent deadlines, and explain what evidence I should preserve.

I rent a home in Victoria. The rental provider ignored serious water leakage for months and now wants to retain my bond for damage caused by the leak. What rights, dispute process, and evidence should I consider under the law that applies in Victoria?

I bought a defective solar-battery system from a Queensland supplier. It has repeatedly failed, but the supplier says the written warranty only permits repairs. What remedies may be available under Commonwealth and Queensland law, and how should I pursue them?

A builder in New South Wales agreed through email and text messages to renovate my kitchen for a fixed price. I paid a large deposit, but the builder abandoned the work and says no contract exists because nothing was signed. What claims, statutory issues, and remedies should I investigate?

I was injured in a supermarket fall in South Australia almost three years ago. How should negligence, contributory fault, damages, pre-action requirements, and limitation deadlines be assessed under the applicable law?

My spouse and I live in Western Australia and are separating after thirteen years. We have two children, a home, superannuation, and unequal incomes. Which federal or Western Australian rules govern parenting, maintenance, and property division, and what practical steps come first?

My father died in Victoria without a will. He was remarried, had children from two relationships, owned a jointly held home, and had superannuation. What forms part of the estate, who may inherit, and what additional documents or decisions are needed?

I own 25% of an Australian proprietary company based in New South Wales. The majority owners removed me from management, deny access to accounts, and diverted work to another company they control. What corporate duties and minority-shareholder remedies may apply?

My employer monitors my work-from-home computer using continuous screenshots, keystroke recording, location tracking, and occasional webcam images. I work in New South Wales for a national company. Which Commonwealth and State privacy or workplace-surveillance rules should be considered?

A former customer in Queensland falsely accused me of fraud in a large Facebook group, and the post has been shared interstate. What law governs a possible defamation claim, what elements and defences matter, and what immediate remedies could reduce the harm?

Victoria Police asked me to attend a station voluntarily to discuss suspected theft and requested my phone. What rights and risks should I understand about legal advice, silence, questioning, searches, and device access before I attend?

My aunt lived in New Zealand but owned a house in Tasmania and investments held through an Australian broker. Her New Zealand will names me as executor. What Tasmanian, Commonwealth, and cross-border probate issues should I investigate?

A customer owes my small business in the Australian Capital Territory A$22,000 for completed consulting work and disputes part of the invoice. What pre-action, tribunal or court, evidence, costs, and enforcement issues should I consider?

An accountant in New South Wales missed a tax deadline and gave advice that caused penalties and a failed business transaction. What Commonwealth tax-review options and NSW professional-negligence issues should I assess, including causation and recoverable loss?

My company in Victoria prepaid a supplier in New South Wales under a contract that selects NSW law and courts. The supplier has stopped delivering and is moving assets to Queensland. What contractual, interim-relief, jurisdiction, and interstate-enforcement issues should I consider?
